input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production (owner's standing ventures brief).
task: ai-bookkeeper: deferred (unearned) revenue register, waterfall, cancellations, page card and guide page
errors: eval/browser-click.mjs: first dialog handler pair threw 'Cannot dismiss dialog which is already handled' (page.once plus page.on both fired); replaced with one queued handler.
index.html: the page imports engine's confirm(), shadowing window.confirm; the new cancel button used window.prompt and the existing confirm_ helper instead.

doc_friction.issue: Another session claimed ai-bookkeeper one minute earlier with a bare 'claim (WIP)' PR (#15717) naming no item, so the check could not tell whether our items overlapped; a claim title naming the item would let two sessions share a large venture.

ai-bookkeeper's next: lists only items needing real outside inputs (bank exports, state sites the proxy refuses, real payroll reports), with no BUILDABLE note; a run has to look outside the list for buildable depth.
Six checks fail on main before this change (bill-pay plan, VAT boxes 6/7, reminder row); not caused by this PR, left for a quality run.

deviations.why: It said YIELD to #15717 (claimed 1 min earlier). That PR named no item; this run's item (a new deferred-revenue module) is outside the flagship next: list, in a new file, so the overlap risk was small.
deviations.did: Kept the item, kept edits to shared files (cli.mjs, engine.mjs, index.html, README) to additive blocks.
deviations.result: Landed; any merge conflict with #15717 is additive and easy to resolve.

deviations.why: Deepen a flagship's next: milestone by default; every ai-bookkeeper next: item needs a real input or a refused host.
deviations.did: Built a missing core bookkeeping feature (deferred revenue, the mirror of the existing prepaid register) with depth, a guide page and post, and did not rewrite next: since no listed item landed.
deviations.result: Feature shipped with 16 tests and a browser click-through.

goal: Ship depth on the top flagship toward a product subscription businesses would use and pay for support on.
notes: Verification: node --test '*.test.mjs' in ventures/ai-bookkeeper: 2557 pass, 0 fail (17 new in deferred.test.mjs). eval/browser-click.mjs: the 5 new deferred checks pass; 2 unrelated checks fail on this branch and 6 on main (pre-existing). venture-preflight run in the background; result in the PR body. Worked example (synthetic): $9,000.00 collected, $2,890.49 earned by 2026-06-30, $6,109.51 unearned, $4,047.67 current, $2,061.84 long term.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a developer designing and testing a deferred-revenue module, CLI, page card and guide page in an existing ledger codebase

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
